title: Class II device recall: ETHILON Nylon Suture, Product Code 697G
summary: Nylon suture indicated for use in general soft tissue approximation and/or ligation may have needles with distorted curvature, that may break during use, or could cause additional soft tissue or vessel injury, including tearing or bleeding intraoperatively.
place: International distribution to the countries of JP, CA, AU.
